name: cc-exporter
description: List, read and export your local Claude Code sessions in full detail (Markdown, HTML, JSON).
long_description: Reads the Claude Code transcripts stored on this computer (~/.claude/projects) and exports any session with every prompt, reply, thinking block, tool call with its input and output, file diff, subagent transcript, injected context and token usage. Exports are a self-contained searchable HTML page, Markdown with images saved beside it, and structured JSON. Optional redaction masks keys, tokens, passwords, emails and your home path. Nothing leaves your computer.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List Claude Code sessions on this computer, newest first.

tools.name: read_session
tools.description: Return a session transcript as Markdown, paged, for reading or summarizing.

tools.name: export_session
tools.description: Write a session to HTML, Markdown and/or JSON files in full detail.
